description: OpenAI Responses API with one function tool call, then an answer, traced by OpenInference.
notes: OpenInference records message content by default, and this scenario sets no content-capture environment variable. The first response calls get_weather. The second sends that call and the tool result, then returns text. Token counts are copied: the second span's prompt is 131 and prompt_details.cache_read is 64, with cache_write and reasoning written as 0. Input messages are indexed from 1. Neither span sets llm.finish_reason. The text answer is under message.contents.

message.text: It is 18 °C and sunny in Paris.
